findings.evidence: CharacteristicHomotopy.lean:217 `obtain ⟨H, hH1, hH0⟩ := R.exists_annulus_homotopy hr` and :236 `let τ : C(I, I) := ⟨fun t ↦ projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one (4 * t - 2), by fun_prop⟩`, both repeated in InnerDisc.lean:175 and the `τ` definition right after it. A grep for `exists_homotopy_of_innerDisc|Morse.Cell.InnerDisc` finds no use outside InnerDisc.lean, while the only real comparison proof uses the private copy.
findings.fix: Make CharacteristicHomotopy import InnerDisc (no cycle). In `exists_homotopy_morseCharacteristicMap_polarFactor`, call `exists_homotopy_morseCharacteristicMap_of_innerDisc_of_homotopyRel` with the rescaled homotopy `G'(t, v) = G(t, √ε • v)` on `closedBall 0 d`. The end conditions follow from `symm_smallDiscPoint` and `morseCellMap_smul`, and `hGd` from `hGf` since `‖√ε v‖² = εd²` when `‖v‖ = d`. Then delete the two private theorems and their helpers `morseAnnulusIsometryMap`, `coe_morseAnnulusIsometryMap_apply`, `coe_morseAnnulusIsometryMap_zero`, `apply_morseAnnulusIsometryMap_one_le` and `smallDiscPoint`.
findings.issue: The private `exists_morseAnnulus_homotopy` and `exists_homotopy_morseCharacteristicMap_of_negativeDisc` (lines 192–283) repeat the construction of the new `exists_homotopy_of_innerDisc_of_homotopyRel` (InnerDisc.lean:133–231): the same `Kc`, the same `R.exists_annulus_homotopy`, the same `τ`, and the same seam glue (`diskCollar` here, `discGlue` there). The new theorem with `P = PUnit` covers this case, so the repo now has two copies of Milnor's Remark 3.3 assembly.

summary: The new family theorem `exists_homotopy_of_innerDisc_of_homotopyRel` builds the same homotopy, in the same steps, as an existing private construction in `CharacteristicHomotopy.lean` (inner-circle homotopy `Kc`, `exists_annulus_homotopy`, time map `τ = projIcc(4t-2)`, glue along the radius-`d` seam). That existing proof should be rewritten on top of the new general theorem rather than kept as a parallel copy.
